statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = len(s), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), r[i] is the largest integer k with 0 <= k <= len(s)-i such that, if the robot starts at (startPos[0], startPos[1]) and executes s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[i+k-1] in order (L: column-1, R: column+1, U: row-1, D: row+1), then after each of these k instructions its cell (row, col) satisfies 0 <= row < n and 0 <= col < n. The case k=0 is vacuously true.
